purpose: Twenty-second-pass official and first-party verification for eight time-sensitive or open Batch-51 rows while the same V53 task remains pickup-timeout claimable. No second task, runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction records, current first-party operator pages, Companies House records, NHS/CQC records and official local-authority planning or licensing routes are promoted. Directory-only claims, snippets and inferred lease completion are rejected.
method.current_status_policy: A current site, company filing, regulatory registration, recruitment advert or licensing application verifies only the fact stated by that source. It does not prove executed lease terms, legal completion, occupational rights or exact parcel geometry.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.
